### Compare variables distributions (standariezed)

```{r}
# R
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# --- ítems subjetivos (explícitos) ---
fonasa_items <- c(
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_1","fonasa_pos_comp_subj_2","fonasa_pos_comp_subj_3",
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_4","fonasa_pos_comp_subj_5","fonasa_pos_comp_subj_6",
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_7","fonasa_pos_comp_subj_8","fonasa_pos_comp_subj_9",
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_10"
)
sae_items <- c(
  "sae_pos_comp_subj_1","sae_pos_comp_subj_2","sae_pos_comp_subj_3",
  "sae_pos_comp_subj_4","sae_pos_comp_subj_5","sae_pos_comp_subj_6",
  "sae_pos_comp_subj_7","sae_pos_comp_subj_8","sae_pos_comp_subj_9"
)

# comprobar existencia de columnas
stopifnot(all(c(fonasa_items, sae_items,
                "fonasa_comp_objetiva_pos","sae_comp_objetiva_pos",
                "fonasa_conf_belief_funcional_pos","sae_conf_belief_funcional_pos",
                "fonasa_conf_belief_moral_pos","sae_conf_belief_moral_pos") %in% names(data)))

# calcular media por participante de los ítems subjetivos (>=50% respondidos)
min_prop <- 0.5
fonasa_req <- ceiling(length(fonasa_items) * min_prop)
sae_req    <- ceiling(length(sae_items) * min_prop)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    fonasa_subj_n = rowSums(!is.na(select(., all_of(fonasa_items)))),
    fonasa_subj_mean_raw = if_else(fonasa_subj_n >= fonasa_req,
                                   rowMeans(select(., all_of(fonasa_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
                                   NA_real_),
    sae_subj_n = rowSums(!is.na(select(., all_of(sae_items)))),
    sae_subj_mean_raw = if_else(sae_subj_n >= sae_req,
                                rowMeans(select(., all_of(sae_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
                                NA_real_)
  )

# normalizar a [0,1] cada constructo por su rango observado
norm01 <- function(x){
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (any(is.na(rng)) || diff(rng) == 0) return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  (x - rng[1]) / diff(rng)
}

measures_long <- data %>%
  transmute(
    FONASA_objective = (fonasa_comp_objetiva_pos - 1) / (11 - 1),
    SAE_objective    = (sae_comp_objetiva_pos - 1) / (6 - 1),
    FONASA_functional = (fonasa_conf_belief_funcional_pos - 1) / (7 - 1),
    SAE_functional    = (sae_conf_belief_funcional_pos - 1) / (7 - 1),
    FONASA_moral = (fonasa_conf_belief_moral_pos - 1) / (7 - 1),
    SAE_moral    = (sae_conf_belief_moral_pos - 1) / (7 - 1),
    FONASA_subjective = norm01(fonasa_subj_mean_raw),
    SAE_subjective    = norm01(sae_subj_mean_raw)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "measure", values_to = "score_norm") %>%
  mutate(
    system = case_when(
      grepl("^FONASA", measure) ~ "FONASA",
      grepl("^SAE", measure) ~ "SAE"
    ),
    construct = case_when(
      grepl("objective", measure)   ~ "Objective knowledge",
      grepl("functional", measure)  ~ "Functional trust",
      grepl("moral", measure)       ~ "Moral trust",
      grepl("subjective", measure)  ~ "Subjective knowledge"
    )
  )

# plot: 2 filas x 2 columnas
ggplot(measures_long, aes(x = score_norm, fill = system)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.4, na.rm = TRUE) +
  facet_wrap(~ construct, ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    x = "Normalized position in scale",
    y = "Density",
    fill = "System",
    title = "Comparación FONASA vs SAE: Objective / Functional / Moral / Subjective"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
# R
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

# variables explícitas (ya las enumeraste)
fonasa_items <- c(
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_1",
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_2",
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_3",
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_4",
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_5",
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_6",
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_7",
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_8",
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_9",
  "fonasa_pos_comp_subj_10"
)

sae_items <- c(
  "sae_pos_comp_subj_1",
  "sae_pos_comp_subj_2",
  "sae_pos_comp_subj_3",
  "sae_pos_comp_subj_4",
  "sae_pos_comp_subj_5",
  "sae_pos_comp_subj_6",
  "sae_pos_comp_subj_7",
  "sae_pos_comp_subj_8",
  "sae_pos_comp_subj_9"
)

# comprobar que las columnas existen
stopifnot(all(c(fonasa_items, sae_items) %in% names(data)))

# calcular medias por fila (requiriendo >=50% ítems respondidos)
min_prop <- 0.5
fonasa_req <- ceiling(length(fonasa_items) * min_prop)
sae_req <- ceiling(length(sae_items) * min_prop)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    fonasa_subj_n = rowSums(!is.na(select(., all_of(fonasa_items)))),
    fonasa_subj_mean_raw = if_else(
      fonasa_subj_n >= fonasa_req,
      rowMeans(select(., all_of(fonasa_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    sae_subj_n = rowSums(!is.na(select(., all_of(sae_items)))),
    sae_subj_mean_raw = if_else(
      sae_subj_n >= sae_req,
      rowMeans(select(., all_of(sae_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

# normalizar cada mean a [0,1] por rango observado (evita división por cero)
norm01 <- function(x) {
  rng <- range(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (any(is.na(rng)) || diff(rng) == 0) {
    return(rep(NA_real_, length(x)))
  }
  (x - rng[1]) / diff(rng)
}

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    fonasa_subj_mean = norm01(fonasa_subj_mean_raw),
    sae_subj_mean = norm01(sae_subj_mean_raw)
  )

# preparar long para graficar
comp_long <- data %>%
  select(fonasa_subj_mean, sae_subj_mean) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "system", values_to = "score") %>%
  mutate(
    system = recode(system, fonasa_subj_mean = "FONASA", sae_subj_mean = "SAE")
  )

# histograma comparado (densidad normalizada) + curvas de densidad
p_subj_comp <- ggplot(
  comp_long,
  aes(x = score, fill = system, color = system)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = ..density..),
    position = "identity",
    alpha = 0.35,
    bins = 30,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0, size = 1, na.rm = TRUE) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparación: conocimiento subjetivo (media ítems, normalizado 0–100%)",
    x = "Posición normalizada en la escala (0 = mínimo observado, 1 = máximo observado)",
    y = "Densidad",
    fill = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

p_subj_comp
```

# Estrategia 2. Tricotomizar y modelo multinomial

## Construcción de la variable

- Normalización de las variables de conocimiento y confianza (z-scores)
- Clasificación en categorías: z > 0, z <= 0.
- Creación de categorías combinadas para cada sistema, con base en la combinación.
- Fundición de categorías con baja confianza para ganar poder estadístico.

```{r}
library(nnet)

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    z_know_fonasa = as.numeric(scale(fonasa_comp_objetiva_pos)),
    z_trust_func_fonasa = as.numeric(scale(fonasa_conf_belief_funcional_pos)),
    z_trust_moral_fonasa = as.numeric(scale(fonasa_conf_belief_moral_pos))
  )

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    fonasa_calibrated_misinfo_func = case_when(
      z_know_fonasa >= 0 & z_trust_func_fonasa >= 0 ~ "Informed trust",
      z_know_fonasa < 0 & z_trust_func_fonasa >= 0 ~ "Ignorant trust",
      z_trust_func_fonasa < 0 ~ "Skeptical informed / mistrust uninformed"
    )
  )

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    fonasa_calibrated_misinfo_moral = case_when(
      z_know_fonasa >= 0 & z_trust_moral_fonasa >= 0 ~ "Informed trust",
      z_know_fonasa < 0 & z_trust_moral_fonasa >= 0 ~ "Ignorant trust",
      z_trust_moral_fonasa < 0 ~ "Skeptical informed / mistrust uninformed"
    )
  )

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    fonasa_calibrated_funcional_cat = relevel(
      factor(fonasa_calibrated_misinfo_func),
      ref = "Skeptical informed / mistrust uninformed"
    ),
    fonasa_calibrated_moral_cat = relevel(
      factor(fonasa_calibrated_misinfo_moral),
      ref = "Skeptical informed / mistrust uninformed"
    )
  )

ivs_intervencion <- c(
  "ai_disclosure_fonasa",
  "control_humano_fonasa",
  "performance_fonasa"
)

ivs_demograficas <- c(
  "genero",
  "edad_num",
  "education_recoded"
)
```

```{r}
library(scales)

vars_interes <- c(
  "ai_disclosure_fonasa",
  "control_humano_fonasa",
  "performance_fonasa"
)

etiquetas_vars <- c(
  ai_disclosure_fonasa = "AI disclosure",
  control_humano_fonasa = "Human control",
  performance_fonasa = "Performance"
)

plot_data_func <- data |>
  select(fonasa_calibrated_funcional_cat, all_of(vars_interes)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(vars_interes),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "valor"
  ) |>
  count(fonasa_calibrated_funcional_cat, variable, valor) |>
  group_by(fonasa_calibrated_funcional_cat, variable) |>
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    label = percent(prop, accuracy = 1)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    variable = recode(variable, !!!etiquetas_vars),
    valor = factor(valor, levels = c(0, 1))
  )

p_func <- ggplot(
  plot_data_func,
  aes(
    y = variable,
    x = prop,
    fill = factor(valor)
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ fonasa_calibrated_funcional_cat, ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Informed Functional trust",
    x = "Percentage",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

plot_data_moral <- data |>
  select(fonasa_calibrated_moral_cat, all_of(vars_interes)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(vars_interes),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "valor"
  ) |>
  count(fonasa_calibrated_moral_cat, variable, valor) |>
  group_by(fonasa_calibrated_moral_cat, variable) |>
  mutate(
    prop = n / sum(n),
    label = percent(prop, accuracy = 1)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  mutate(
    variable = recode(variable, !!!etiquetas_vars),
    valor = factor(valor, levels = c(0, 1))
  )

p_moral <- ggplot(
  plot_data_moral,
  aes(
    y = variable,
    x = prop,
    fill = factor(valor)
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = label),
    position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
    size = 3
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ fonasa_calibrated_moral_cat, ncol = 1) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title = "Informed Moral trust",
    x = "Percentage",
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Value"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_func / p_moral
```

```{r}
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    z_know_sae = as.numeric(scale(sae_comp_objetiva_pos)),
    z_trust_func_sae = as.numeric(scale(sae_conf_belief_funcional_pos)),
    z_trust_moral_sae = as.numeric(scale(sae_conf_belief_moral_pos))
  )

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    sae_calibrated_misinfo_func = case_when(
      z_know_sae >= 0 & z_trust_func_sae >= 0 ~ "Informed trust",
      z_know_sae < 0 & z_trust_func_sae >= 0 ~ "Ignorant trust",
      z_trust_func_sae < 0 ~ "Skeptical informed / mistrust uninformed"
    )
  )

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    sae_calibrated_misinfo_moral = case_when(
      z_know_sae >= 0 & z_trust_moral_sae >= 0 ~ "Informed trust",
      z_know_sae < 0 & z_trust_moral_sae >= 0 ~ "Ignorant trust",
      z_trust_moral_sae < 0 ~ "Skeptical informed / mistrust uninformed"
    )
  )

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    sae_calibrated_funcional_cat = relevel(
      factor(sae_calibrated_misinfo_func),
      ref = "Skeptical informed / mistrust uninformed"
    ),
    sae_calibrated_moral_cat = relevel(
      factor(sae_calibrated_misinfo_moral),
      ref = "Skeptical informed / mistrust uninformed"
    )
  )

ivs_intervencion <- c(
  "disclosure",
  "control_humano",
  "inf_situacional"
)

ivs_demograficas <- c(
  "genero",
  "edad_num",
  "education_recoded"
)
```

```{r}
library(scales)

  mutate(
```

### Sistema como control (Multinomial con ambos sistemas)

```{r}
# R
# Construir constructos (media de ítems) para FONASA y SAE
library(dplyr)

# detectar ítems (si no existen ya los vectores items_...)
items_fonasa_trust <- names(data)[grepl(
  "^fonasa_pos_trust_belief.*_[0-9]+$",
  names(data)
)]
items_sae_trust <- names(data)[grepl(
  "^sae_pos_trust_belief.*_[0-9]+$",
  names(data)
)]

# Umbral mínimo de ítems respondidos (50%)
min_prop <- 0.5

# matrices de ítems
mat_fonasa <- data |> select(all_of(items_fonasa_trust))
mat_sae <- data |> select(all_of(items_sae_trust))

# conteo no-missing y media condicionada
req_fonasa <- ceiling(ncol(mat_fonasa) * min_prop)
req_sae <- ceiling(ncol(mat_sae) * min_prop)

data <- data |>
  mutate(
    fonasa_trust_n = rowSums(!is.na(mat_fonasa)),
    fonasa_trust_mean = if_else(
      fonasa_trust_n >= req_fonasa,
      rowMeans(mat_fonasa, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    ),
    sae_trust_n = rowSums(!is.na(mat_sae)),
    sae_trust_mean = if_else(
      sae_trust_n >= req_sae,
      rowMeans(mat_sae, na.rm = TRUE),
      NA_real_
    )
  )

# Resúmenes útiles
resumen_constructos <- tibble(
  construct = c("fonasa_trust_mean", "sae_trust_mean"),
  n_nonmissing = c(
    sum(!is.na(data$fonasa_trust_mean)),
    sum(!is.na(data$sae_trust_mean))
  ),
  mean = c(
    mean(data$fonasa_trust_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(data$sae_trust_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  median = c(
    median(data$fonasa_trust_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    median(data$sae_trust_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  sd = c(
    sd(data$fonasa_trust_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd(data$sae_trust_mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

resumen_constructos |> kable()
```
